vulnerability_analysis: The HuskyInu contract has an addBlacklist function that is only callable by the owner. The vulnerability demonstrates that the owner has unchecked power to blacklist any address, which could be used maliciously to block legitimate users. The exploit requires becoming the owner first, then calling addBlacklist.
attack_strategy: 1. Use storage slot manipulation to become the contract owner. 2. Call addBlacklist to blacklist the dead address (0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD).
step_by_step_plan: 1. Calculate the storage slot for the owner variable (slot 0 in Ownable). 2. Use vm.store to write attacker address to owner slot. 3. Impersonate as attacker (already address(this)). 4. Call addBlacklist on target contract with dead address and true. 5. Verify blacklist mapping returns true.
